component.name: Squeak
component.summary: Open-source HID++ 2.0 peripheral configurator for Linux

description.p: Squeak is an open-source Linux desktop application, background daemon, and CLI for configuring HID++ 2.0 pointing devices without proprietary software.

ul.li: Adjustable sensor DPI, polling report rate, and scroll wheel settings
Interactive mouse button diagram with button remapping and live spy mode
Per-zone RGB lighting effects with interactive color picker
Onboard memory profile switching, sector backup, and restore
XDG TOML software profiles with per-application auto-switching on GNOME, KDE Plasma, and Hyprland

description.p: Initial release with hidpp protocol crate, squeakd D-Bus daemon, squeak CLI, GTK4/libadwaita GUI, and per-app software profiles.
